judgements.what: Claims mapped to more than one objective
judgements.detail: CLM-0460-3.4-001 serves 3.4.1-01 and 3.4.1-02 (receiving-area definition anchors both); CLM-0460-3.4-004/007 are misconception-correction claims attached to the objective their entry names; CLM-0460-3.4-012/013 also serve 3.4.1-03 in P01. All mappings are ones the claims genuinely serve (C-04 backed).
The work order leaves these to choice; the case-study answer exercises the case study plus benefits and management, and the data-response exercises growth and impacts.
